_comment: Render-only settings shared by render_preview.py and render_variants.py. Nothing here affects exported game data.

hdri._comment: Poly Haven 'Qwantani Late Afternoon' (CC0), 4k Radiance HDR; fetched by scripts/fetch_tools.ps1 into tools/hdri (gitignored). The sun disk is clamped to sun_clamp and replaced by a sun lamp along the HDRI sun direction carrying the clamped-away irradiance (x sun_scale). sun_azimuth_deg places the sun around the vehicle (0 = ahead/+Y, 90 = right/+X, 180 = behind); views may override it.

ground._comment: Two-lane road along Y; the vehicle sits in the right-hand lane centred on x = 0. Ground fades to transparent (HDRI horizon) between fade_start..fade_end m.

surface._comment: Fast Surface Pro preview: Eevee, 32 TAA samples, soft shadows, GTAO, SSR, bloom.

surface-photo._comment: Photoreal Surface Pro render: Cycles CPU, adaptive sampling, OpenImageDenoise, Filmic High Contrast, slight DOF (view fstop). Target < 4 min per 1280x720 view on an i7-1185G7.

gaming._comment: Gaming PC: Cycles GPU, 1080p, 256 samples (device must be enabled in Blender preferences there).

views._comment: Auto-framed cameras (lib/environment.place_camera): azimuth_deg 0 = in front, 90 = right, 180 = behind, 270 = left; height/target_height in m above ground; margin = empty border fraction; fstop used only when the profile has dof.
views._side_comment: Side: camera 9 deg forward of square (a sliver of the shaded nose shows) with the sun low behind-left (205) raking along the flank; a sun behind the camera (old 252) flattened the paint and turned dark glass/graphics mid-grey.
